'''The Easter Bunny Hop''' is a RACE tournament. It will be single-elimination bracket, where every round players are faced head to head in duel races. Best of 5 runs. Each run is won simply by the player who first reach the end of the map.
== Format ==
* SUNDAY, April 5 - 22:00 CEST
* Mode: RACE
* All matches are BO5, except final BO7
* All regions(EU/NA) welcome
